scripts.build: haxe build.hxml -D rad-target=${RAD_TARGET:-example} && sass --pkg-importer=node --no-source-map targets/${RAD_TARGET:-example}/theme.scss web/rad.css && esbuild build/rad.js --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/rad.js
scripts.dev: haxe build.hxml -D rad-target=${RAD_TARGET:-example} && (sass --pkg-importer=node --no-source-map targets/${RAD_TARGET:-example}/theme.scss web/rad.css --watch & esbuild build/rad.js --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/rad.js --watch=forever --servedir=web & watchexec -e hx,hxml,json -w src -w build.hxml -w targets haxe build.hxml -D rad-target=${RAD_TARGET:-example})
